questions.prompt: Match each quantity to its unit.
questions.explanation: Voltage is the push (volts), current the flow (amps), resistance how hard it is to pass (ohms), and power how fast energy is used (watts).

questions.prompt: A relay coil rated 24 V DC has a resistance of 1.2 kΩ. How much current does it draw, in milliamps?
A 24 V DC pilot light draws 50 mA. What is its resistance, in ohms?
A 120 V AC contactor coil draws 0.25 A. How much power does it use, in watts?
The wire from a proximity sensor to a PLC input is cut. What does the PLC input read?
options: FALSE all the time, whatever the sensor does
TRUE all the time, whatever the sensor does
The same as before: the PLC remembers the last value
It switches between TRUE and FALSE
questions.explanation: A cut wire is an open circuit: no current reaches the input, so it reads FALSE. A short would make it read TRUE.
